# Auralis Natura — Holistic Health

> Academically-founded holistic health & nutrition coaching by Dr. rer. nat. Desiree Gruber (Barcelona; online worldwide). Evidence-led, nature-rooted guidance for energy, women's health and wellbeing. This is coaching and education — not medical advice.

## About
- Founder: Dr. rer. nat. Desiree Gruber — doctorate (Dr. rer. nat.) in bioorganic chemistry; 10+ years in pharmaceutical quality (Novartis, Barcelona); certified holistic health consultant; women's health specialist; certified yoga & meditation teacher.
- Method: the Auralis Method — Listen, Analyse, Align, Sustain. Evidence before advice; a plan built around the individual.
- Languages: English, Spanish, German. Format: fully online.

## Services
- The Root Session — €198 — a focused 90-minute deep-dive with a personalised written report.
- The Bloom — €398 — a structured 6-week guided programme.
- The Flourishing — €798 — a complete 12-week guided journey.
- The Grove — bespoke (request a quote) — corporate nutrition & wellbeing workshops for teams.
- Free 25-minute discovery call (the first step).

## Important / scope
- Holistic health and nutrition coaching for general wellbeing and education only. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease and is not a substitute for medical care.
- "Dr." denotes a doctorate in bioorganic chemistry, not a medical qualification; not a physician and not a registered "dietista-nutricionista". Coaching complements, never replaces, medical care.
